chapter: Billy Berg's, Granz and Nat Cole
title: New songs and a tuba ensemble piece for New York
summary: He mentions a new lyric by Mary Lou, plans to push his songs, and pieces for tubas sent to Bob Stewart and Howard Johnson.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Yeah. I'm in love with it. It's really a great lyric. And also another thing, "Birds On the Wing," which I am hoping to get to Ella or Sarah. I think they might like that one. I've been writing songs most of my life, but I've been a little too shy to push them, except some of those that people just demanded that they do.
Well, don't be shy. Let people know you have them.
Well, I am. From now on, I am going to be real serious about pushing my music.

As a matter of fact, when I leave here today, I'm mailing some things to Bob Stewart and Howard Johnson. That's for five tubas and alto saxophone, flugelhorn and trombone and keyboards. I think it's going to be performed on September 20th, I don't know where, but in New York.
That should be interesting to hear.
